title: IRepair: An Intent-Aware Approach to Repair Data-Driven Errors in Large Language Models
findings: This paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion, faith, or religious bias. Its focus is on a general method for repairing data-driven errors, with a case study on toxicity.
